### Place type vs. Distance from home vs. Sex contact  {.unnumbered}


::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Show plot


```{r plot_radar_facet_placetype_placesex_distancefromhome}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-align: center

make_table_freq3( placeType, distanceFromHome, placeSex, person_analysis = FALSE) |>
  plot_radar_stratified2()  +
  scale_fill_mpxnyc(name = "") +
  scale_radial_mpxnyc() +
  theme_mpxnyc_radar_places() +
  theme_mpxnyc_nomargin()


```


#### Show data


```{r table_radar_facet_placetype_placesex_distancefromhome}


make_table_freq3( placeType, distanceFromHome, placeSex, person_analysis = FALSE)  |>
  draw_table_3("Venue type by home distance and sexual contact")



```
